Closest evidence: [TLSRec (CIKM 2022)](https://yneversky.github.io/Papers/cikm22.pdf) compares against SASRec and TiSASRec, combining hierarchical attention, session pooling and a time-lag-dependent fusion gate. Its ablations remove short-/long-term attention and replace gating with alternative fusion. [TiSASRec (WSDM 2020)](https://jiachengli1995.github.io/files/wsdm20.pdf) isolates timestamp modeling through pairwise time intervals and positional encoding comparisons. These support related mechanisms; neither establishes the exact proposed SASRec-plus-gated-recent-pooling architecture or separates its benefit from extra LayerNorm and parameters.

Baseline preservation requires matching the actual RecHarness implementation. The [original SASRec code](https://github.com/kang205/SASRec/blob/master/model.py) scales input item embeddings by √d, adds positional embeddings, uses causal attention, masks padding and applies final normalization; its [attention implementation](https://github.com/kang205/SASRec/blob/master/modules.py) adds normalized queries residually. Proposed implementation guidance: pool only nonpadding positions j≤t within each training position’s recent window; handle empty windows safely. Use h′=h+α·branch_LN(r), with α initialized exactly zero, to preserve baseline outputs initially. A sigmoid gate with zero bias equals 0.5; a negative bias only approximates disabling. Adding LN after the residual changes the baseline mapping even when α=0. Compute timestamp ages from observable prefix times, excluding held-out target timestamps.

Recommended controlled ablations: unchanged SASRec; SASRec plus the proposed extra normalization alone; a parameter-matched gated MLP using only h; recent pooling without timestamps; recent pooling with timestamp decay; uniform versus learned pooling; fixed versus learned gates. Match normalization placement across branch controls, training settings and validation candidates. Select using four-category macro validation HR@10 and report category deltas. These comparisons distinguish recent-context information, temporal weighting, normalization and added capacity.
